g.text: Rooftop arrays double in size at the German border

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5540

g.text: Left: median mapped array by distance to the border. France is flat at about 21 m² right up to

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5540

g.text: it. The German series sits far higher but is erratic, because German OSM covers only ~3.6% of

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5540

g.text: registered units and favours large arrays. Right: the unbiased version, both complete registers

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5540

g.text: cut to the same sub-36 kW band. The real step is 1.95x, not the ~5x the left panel suggests.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5540

g.text: Same climate and building stock either side, different feed-in tariff history.
